contenders.handicapper_notes: Profiles perfectly for the 2026 Hannans Handicap. Ships in from Belmont following a sharp 3rd in the Listed Farnley Stakes over 1400m behind Too Dardy. Ran 3rd in this exact feature last year carrying 57kg and gets in lightly weighted at 56kg. Low gate 4 guarantees a golden box-seat run behind the speed, ideal for Kalgoorlie short 320m straight. Canonical style code P.

Brings the best last-start Perth metropolitan winning form into the race, having taken down Too Dardy in a 1600m BM84+ handicap at Belmont on September 19. Drops back to 1400m in peak 3rd-up condition with top Perth jockey Chris Parnham retaining the ride. Outstanding soft track stats (10: 4-0-1). Canonical style code P.

High-class sprinting mare who produced an eye-catching late rush when 4th beaten just 1.4 lengths in the Nicopolis Stakes (1200m) first-up. Proven at 1400m with five career wins at the trip and gets in favorably at 56kg. Drawn favorably in barrier 5 to track midfield before unleashing her turn of foot. Canonical style code S.

Savvy veteran who ran a credible 4th in the Listed Farnley Stakes last start beaten under 3 lengths. Secures the prized fence draw in gate 1 with the minimum featherweight of 54kg (119 lbs). Highly experienced over 1400m (36 starts for 8 wins) and will save critical ground around the Goldfields bends. Canonical style code P.

Consistent Pearce-trained campaigner reaching peak fitness third-up. Produced solid closing sectionals when 5th in the Nicopolis Stakes at Belmont. The 1400m chute allows jockey Clint Johnston-Porter ample time to navigate across from barrier 11 without getting caught wide. Canonical style code P.
